#Load data
```{r}
# Read in 
read_compartment <- function(path, suffix, key_cols) {
  all_cols <- names(vroom(path, n_max = 0, num_threads = 8,
                          show_col_types = FALSE))

  suffixed <- if_else(all_cols %in% key_cols,
                      all_cols,
                      paste0(all_cols, suffix))

  df <- vroom(path,
              num_threads = 8,
              col_select = everything(),
              show_col_types = FALSE)

  setNames(df, suffixed)
}
# Add a suffix dependent on cellular compartment and tell me breakdown info
report_plate_features <- function(merged_df, plate_name) {
  all_cols <- names(merged_df)
  
  compartment_counts <- list(
    nuclei    = sum(str_detect(all_cols, "_nuclei$")),
    cytoplasm = sum(str_detect(all_cols, "_cytoplasm$")),
    cells     = sum(str_detect(all_cols, "_cells$")),
    key_cols  = sum(!str_detect(all_cols, "_(nuclei|cytoplasm|cells)$"))
  )
  
  message(sprintf(
    "\n── %s ──\n  nuclei: %d | cytoplasm: %d | cells: %d | key/other: %d | TOTAL cols: %d",
    plate_name,
    compartment_counts$nuclei,
    compartment_counts$cytoplasm,
    compartment_counts$cells,
    compartment_counts$key_cols,
    ncol(merged_df)
  ))
  
  invisible(compartment_counts)
}

# Merge into 1 df
merge_plate <- function(plate_dir) {
  cells_path <- file.path(plate_dir, "Cells.csv")
  if (!file.exists(cells_path)) {
    message("Skipping empty folder: ", plate_dir)
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  key_cols <- names(vroom(cells_path, n_max = 0, show_col_types = FALSE))[1:7]
  
  try_read <- function(filename, suffix) {
    path <- file.path(plate_dir, filename)
    if (!file.exists(path)) {
      message("  Skipping missing file: ", path)
      return(NULL)
    }
    read_compartment(path, suffix, key_cols)
  }
  
  Cells     <- try_read("Cells.csv",     "_cells")
  Cytoplasm <- try_read("Cytoplasm.csv", "_cytoplasm")
  Nuclei    <- try_read("Nuclei.csv",    "_nuclei")
  
  compartments <- Filter(Negate(is.null), list(Cells, Cytoplasm, Nuclei))
  if (length(compartments) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  merged <- if (length(compartments) == 1) {
    compartments[[1]]
  } else {
    join_keys <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(compartments, names))
    Reduce(function(a, b) full_join(a, b, by = join_keys), compartments)
  }
  
  report_plate_features(merged, basename(plate_dir))
  merged
}

merge_data <- function(cell_profiler_process_path, plates = NULL) {
  if (is.null(plates)) {
    plates <- list.dirs(cell_profiler_process_path,
                        recursive = FALSE, full.names = FALSE)
    plates <- plates[str_detect(plates, "^Plate")]
  }
  
  result <- vector("list", length(plates))
  for (i in seq_along(plates)) {
    plate_dir  <- file.path(cell_profiler_process_path, plates[[i]])
    message("Reading: ", plate_dir)
    result[[i]] <- merge_plate(plate_dir)
    gc()
  }
  
  combined <- bind_rows(result)
  
  message("\n══ COMBINED DATASET ══")
  report_plate_features(combined, "ALL PLATES")
  message(sprintf("  rows: %d | plates loaded: %d",
                  nrow(combined), sum(!sapply(result, is.null))))
  
  combined
}
```

#Normalization
```{r}
# Eliminate wells with fewer than 50 valid objects
df_50cells <- all_data %>%
  group_by(Metadata_Plate, Metadata_Well) %>%
  filter(n() >= 50) %>%
  ungroup()

rm(all_data); gc()

# Remove columns that are all NA or all 0 (keeping Metadata_ columns)
metadata_cols <- grepl("^Metadata_", names(df_50cells))

keep <- metadata_cols | (
  colSums(is.na(df_50cells)) < nrow(df_50cells) &
  colSums(df_50cells == 0, na.rm = TRUE) < nrow(df_50cells)

)

df_50cells <- df_50cells[, keep]
test_chem <- df_50cells
rm(df_50cells); gc()

#Normalization
##calculate ctrl(solvent) median and median absolute deviation (MAD) using all control cells across the plates
ctrl_cells <- subset(test_chem,  Metadata_Chemical %in% ctrl_group)

# Separate metadata and feature columns
metadata_cols <- ctrl_cells[, 1:7]
feature_cols  <- ctrl_cells[, 8:ncol(ctrl_cells)]

# ctrl median
ctrl_med <- as.data.frame(t(apply(feature_cols, 2, function(x) median(x, na.rm = TRUE))))
ctrl_med <- ctrl_med[rep(1, nrow(test_chem)), ]

# ctrl MAD
ctrl_mad <- as.data.frame(t(apply(feature_cols, 2, function(x) mad(x, constant = 1, na.rm = TRUE))) * 1.4826)

# Identify features with a MAD of 0
ctrl_mad_zero <- ctrl_mad[, ctrl_mad[1, ] == 0 & !is.na(ctrl_mad[1, ])]

if(ncol(ctrl_mad_zero)>0){
  ctrl_mad_zero <- ctrl_mad_zero[rep(1, nrow(test_chem)), ]
  col_mad_zero <- colnames(ctrl_mad_zero)
}

##Features with non-zero MAD
ctrl_mad <- ctrl_mad[, ctrl_mad[1,]!=0 & !is.na(ctrl_mad[1, ])]
ctrl_mad <- ctrl_mad[rep(1, nrow(test_chem)), ]
col_mad <- colnames(ctrl_mad)


#Normalize all cell-level data to ctrl SD, median, and MAD
print("Calculating standard deviation, median, and median absolute deviation (MAD) of all ctrl cells across the plates")

test_chem_cc <- test_chem %>%
  group_by(Metadata_Well, Metadata_Chemical,Metadata_Concentration, Metadata_Plate) %>%
  mutate(cell_count = n()) %>%
  ungroup()

##Normalize features in test samples
print(paste0("Normalizing cell-level data to ctrl median and MAD"))

test_chem[, col_mad] <- (test_chem[,col_mad] - ctrl_med[,col_mad])/ctrl_mad[,col_mad]

if(ncol(ctrl_mad_zero)>0){
  test_chem[, col_mad_zero] <- (test_chem[, col_mad_zero] - ctrl_med[, col_mad_zero])
  }else{
  rm(ctrl_mad_zero)
  }

rm(ctrl_med, ctrl_mad, ctrl_mad_zero); gc()
```






#Aggregate
```{r}
print("Aggregating cell-level data to well-level")

#Calculate the median of all treated wells
#i remove imgae/cell data
test_chem_well <- test_chem %>%
  dplyr::select(-ObjectNumber, -ImageNumber, -Metadata_Site) %>%
  group_by(Metadata_Well, Metadata_Chemical,
           Metadata_Concentration, Metadata_Plate) %>%
  summarize_all(median, na.rm = TRUE) %>%
  ungroup()

#z-standardization: Scale well- and treatment-level data to SD of ctrl
print("Scaling well-level data to SD of vehicle control")

feature_cols  <- names(test_chem_well)[5:ncol(test_chem_well)]

# Compute SD from control wells
ctrl_SD_w <- test_chem_well %>%
  filter(Metadata_Chemical == ctrl_group) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(feature_cols), ~ sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  unlist()


test_chem_well <- test_chem_well %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(feature_cols), ~ .x / ctrl_SD_w[[cur_column()]]))
```

#Cytotoxicity
```{r}
cell_count <- as.data.frame(test_chem_cc)
cell_count$Metadata_Concentration <- cell_count$Metadata_Concentration + 1

#I added group by plate to everything
cell_count_avg <- cell_count %>%
  group_by(Metadata_Chemical, Metadata_Concentration, Metadata_Plate) %>%
  summarise(Average_cc = mean(cell_count),
            SD = sd(cell_count))

cell_count_avg$relative_cc <- cell_count_avg$Average_cc/cell_count_avg[cell_count_avg$Metadata_Chemical== ctrl_group, ]$Average_cc

cell_count_avg$SD_rel_cc <- cell_count_avg$relative_cc*sqrt((cell_count_avg$SD/cell_count_avg$Average_cc)^2 + (cell_count_avg[cell_count_avg$Metadata_Chemical == ctrl_group, ]$SD/cell_count_avg[cell_count_avg$Metadata_Chemical == ctrl_group, ]$Average_cc)^2)

#cut-off for reduction in cell count
cytotoxic_conc <- cell_count_avg %>%
  filter(relative_cc < 0.5)

#Exclude wells with >50% reduction in relative cell count
test_chem_well <- test_chem_well %>%
  filter(!paste(Metadata_Chemical, Metadata_Concentration) %in% paste(cytotoxic_conc$Metadata_Chemical, cytotoxic_conc$Metadata_Concentration))

#Eliminate feats with no variance across samples
variances <- apply(test_chem_well, 2, var)
no_var <- which(variances == 0)

if(length(no_var) != 0 & is.numeric(no_var)){
  test_chem_well <- test_chem_well[, -no_var]
}
```

#New analysis
```{r}
test_chem_well <- read_csv(
    file.path(pipeline_output_path, "test_chem_well.csv")
)

# Split metadata from feature matrix
is_metadata <- grepl("^Metadata_", names(test_chem_well))
metadata_df <- test_chem_well[, is_metadata, drop = FALSE]
feature_mat <- as.matrix(test_chem_well[, !is_metadata, drop = FALSE])

n_features_original <- ncol(feature_mat)
```



##1. Low-variance filter
```{r}
# Drop features with (near-)zero variance across wells
variance_threshold <- 1e-5

variances <- matrixStats::colVars(feature_mat, na.rm = TRUE)
keep_var  <- !is.na(variances) & variances > variance_threshold

cat("Original features:", n_features_original, "\n")
cat("Removed (low variance or all-NA):", sum(!keep_var), "\n")
cat("Remaining after variance filter:", sum(keep_var), "\n")

feature_mat_lowvar <- feature_mat[, keep_var, drop = FALSE]

test_chem_well_lowvar <- bind_cols(metadata_df, as.data.frame(feature_mat_lowvar))

write_csv(test_chem_well_lowvar, file.path(pipeline_output_path, "test_chem_well_lowvariance.csv"))
```

##2. Pearson correlation filter (pycytominer-style), multiple cutoffs
```{r}
# pycytominer's correlation_threshold flags pairs of features correlated
# above `corr_threshold` and, for each flagged pair, drops the member with
# the larger total (summed) correlation to all other features, keeping the
# one with lower overall redundancy. caret::findCorrelation(exact = TRUE)

# pycytominer's correlation_threshold flags pairs of features correlated
# above `corr_threshold` and, for each flagged pair, drops the member with
# the larger total (summed) correlation to all other features, keeping the
# one with lower overall redundancy. caret::findCorrelation(exact = TRUE)

corr_thresholds <- c(0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9)

# Correlation-only filter, applied to ALL features (no prior variance filtering)
corr_matrix_all <- cor(feature_mat, method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

n_na_corr <- sum(is.na(corr_matrix_all))
if (n_na_corr > 0) {
  message(n_na_corr, " NA entries in the correlation matrix (likely constant/all-NA features) set to 0 before filtering")
  corr_matrix_all[is.na(corr_matrix_all)] <- 0
}

# For each threshold, compute retained + removed feature sets
corr_results <- map(corr_thresholds, function(thresh) {
  remove_idx <- findCorrelation(corr_matrix_all, cutoff = thresh, exact = FALSE)

  list(
    retained = bind_cols(metadata_df, as.data.frame(feature_mat[, -remove_idx, drop = FALSE])),
    removed  = bind_cols(metadata_df, as.data.frame(feature_mat[, remove_idx, drop = FALSE]))
  )
})
names(corr_results) <- paste0("pearson_", corr_thresholds)

# The "no threshold" variant only needs to be written once (doesn't depend on cutoff)
corr_none <- bind_cols(metadata_df, as.data.frame(feature_mat))

# Feature counts retained at each cutoff
sapply(corr_results, function(x) ncol(x$retained)) - ncol(metadata_df)

# Write retained + removed files for each threshold
iwalk(corr_results, function(res, name) {
  write_csv(res$retained, file.path(pipeline_output_path, paste0("test_chem_well_", name, ".csv")))
  write_csv(res$removed,  file.path(pipeline_output_path, paste0("test_chem_well_", name, "_removed.csv")))
})

# Write the single "no threshold" file
write_csv(corr_none, file.path(pipeline_output_path, "test_chem_well_pearson_none.csv"))
```

```{r}
plate_no <- unique(cell_count$Metadata_Plate)

plate_plot <- lapply(plate_no, function(x){
  
  plate_data <- cell_count[cell_count$Metadata_Plate == x, ]
  
  # Create an ordered factor for Chemical with ctrl_group first
  plate_data$Metadata_Chemical <- factor(plate_data$Metadata_Chemical, 
                                levels = c(ctrl_group, setdiff(unique(plate_data$Metadata_Chemical), ctrl_group)), 
                                ordered = TRUE)
  
  y_min <- min(plate_data[plate_data$Metadata_Chemical == ctrl_group,]$cell_count)
  y_max <- max(plate_data[plate_data$Metadata_Chemical == ctrl_group,]$cell_count)
  
  plate_plot <- ggplot(plate_data, aes(x=Metadata_Concentration, y=cell_count, colour=Metadata_Chemical)) + 
    geom_point() + 
   # geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = relative_cc - SD_rel_cc, ymax = relative_cc + SD_rel_cc), width = 0.05) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = y_min, ymax = y_max), fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.5) +        
    geom_hline(yintercept = median(plate_data[plate_data$Metadata_Chemical == ctrl_group,]$cell_count), linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    scale_y_continuous() +
    ylim(min(plate_data$cell_count)-50, max(plate_data$cell_count)+50) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    theme(legend.position="none") +
    scale_color_brewer(palette = "Paired") +
    geom_text(aes(label = Metadata_Well), size = 2, vjust = -1, hjust = 0.5) +
    facet_wrap(vars(Metadata_Chemical), scales = "free") +
    ggtitle(paste0("Plate ", x))
  
    plate_plot
  })
```
